items.title: Solana Changelog: August 6, 2026
items.whyYouShouldCare: Updates in the Solana Changelog can enhance network performance, impacting SOL's usability and attractiveness to developers and users.

items.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid faces growing competition while HYPE ETF inflows stall
items.whyYouShouldCare: Increased competition for Hyperliquid may affect its market share, influencing the broader DeFi landscape on Solana and potentially impacting liquidity.

items.title: Solana whales just triggered a countdown that could skyrocket SOL’s daily burn rate by over 1,200%
items.whyYouShouldCare: A significant increase in SOL's burn rate could reduce supply pressure, potentially enhancing SOL's value proposition in the market.
